name: laserlink
description: Controle remoto de laser GRBL: agente no PC da máquina + interface web no PC de projeto

scripts.build: npm run build -w @laserlink/shared && npm run build -w @laserlink/gcode && npm run build -w @laserlink/agent && npm run build -w @laserlink/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @laserlink/shared && npm run build -w @laserlink/gcode && npm run typecheck -w @laserlink/gcode && npm run typecheck -w @laserlink/agent && npm run typecheck -w @laserlink/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @laserlink/shared && npm run build -w @laserlink/gcode && npm test -w @laserlink/gcode && npm test -w @laserlink/agent
